AROUNDTOWN Commercial Properties (ATCP) is the asset management
platform for Aroundtown SA, the largest listed commercial real estate
company in Germany. ATCP acts as owner representative thus managing,
leasing and optimising the commercial real estate portfolio, which, in
addition to typical office properties, also includes industrial,
logistics and retail properties. In addition to our company
headquarters in Berlin, Aroundtown Commercial Properties holds branch
offices in Munich, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Hanover and Leipzig. Our
employees of various nationalities and their performance stand for the
success of our company. Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management
Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across
Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel,
residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial
models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and
development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment
scenarios. Draft or assist with drafting and reviewing Letters of
Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents.
Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room
management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental
communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP
tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis &
Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition
opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare
investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval
documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment
thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models
(Excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development
opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth
feasibility analyses for repositioning, conversion, and development
scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive
market research on target real estate sub-markets, including
supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and
competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and
acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts
through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment
screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional
investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education
& Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate
Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level
qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in
real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset
management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial
modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets;
experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills
Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR
analysis, and scenario modelling — proficiency is non-negotiable.
Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment
presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools
(e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering)
and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks,
Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong
quantitative and analytical thinking — able to cut through
complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with
high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage
multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — ability to
present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior
stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a
strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a
growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages:
Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a
strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your
Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for
professional development and accelerated career progression within a
large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep
cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail,
and development. Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one
of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Very good
IT infrastructure with access to leading AI tools Good atmosphere ,
communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working
atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training
for professional and personal development in our academy
Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and classes

Mobility and flexibility using pool and company cars for the execution
of tasks Exciting virtual programs for childcare with our partner
company Voiio Discounts at selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on
overnight stays and special conditions on food and beverages
Additional days off on Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve Have we sparked

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

The role

As a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.

You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.

You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.

What you’ll do

- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio
- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards
- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability
- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices
- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working
- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution
- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set
- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency
- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows
- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellence

What you’ll bring

- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production
- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory
- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling
- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices
- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus
- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy
- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency
- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment
- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus
- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality
- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English

_________________

Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.

You'll be a trusted partner to Operations, Engineering, and Finance leadership, shaping how HelloFresh invests in and runs its production network. The role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.

What you’ll do

- Design and execute category strategies: spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier landscape assessments, and sourcing roadmaps
- Lead complex RFx events and negotiate high-value contracts delivering TCO savings,not just unit price reductions
- Build and manage preferred supplier portfolio per category: qualification, KPIs, and continuous improvement
- Partner with senior stakeholders in Operations, Engineering, and Finance across multiple European markets
- Translate business needs into procurement strategies proactively.
- Drive governance and best-practice adoption: contract management, supplier risk, and compliance
- Present category strategies and sourcing outcomes clearly to Director and VP-level audiences
- Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in CapEx, MHE, etc. projects.

What you’ll bring

- 5+ years in indirect or operations procurement, with genuine category depth, not surface-level exposure
- Multi-category experience in an operations or manufacturing environment (FM, MRO,, Utilities, etc.); the broader and deeper, the stronger the profile
- Proven strategic sourcing skills: RFx design, complex negotiation, and contract structuring for technically complex purchases
- Track record of influencing and building trust with senior, cross-functional stakeholders across European markets
- Fluent in English; German and/or French language skills are a plus
- Strong analytical mindset:spend data, cost modelling, benchmarking, and business case development
- Able to travel to production sites across Europe, if required.

Please submit your resume in English.

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
